notes.note: Final semantic-guidance follow-up at b8c3159164: the existing three upgrade caller cases now parse displayed commands with a real shell and compare independently expected argv (including homes with spaces), rather than requiring one quote spelling. The existing process-heavy lifecycle classification covers these fixture subprocesses; no product source or scheduler/ACL guard changed. Windows full owners remain lifecycle38 failed/206 passed/3 skipped plus scheduler16 failed/23 passed; these are bounded results, not a full Windows pass. From committed clean b8c3159164, disabling production argument quoting caused all three intended argv assertions to fail while the running-service refusal control passed; byte-exact source restoration then passed4/4. The earlier working-tree readiness attempt had empty committed scope and was invalidated by intervening inputs, so it is not qualification evidence. Outside-agent OAuth and UI-proxy claims/cases remain unchanged; no prose update or journal-runtime claim is justified. #5626 remains open.
